text:
🇨🇳 China’s GDP grew 4.5% year-over-year in Q3 2026, beating the 4.4% consensus and accelerating from 4.3% in Q2.

Growth in the first three quarters reached 4.6%, within the government’s 4.5%-5.0% annual target.

On a sequential basis, GDP rose 1.2% in Q3, up from 0.9% in Q2.

Industrial production accelerated to +5.5% in September, while retail sales rose +1.1%. Fixed-asset investment fell -7.2% year-to-date.

China is on track to meet its growth target without major new stimulus.

name: Deepak Shenoy
zh_summary: @deepakshenoy 討論中國早前禁止 Facebook 和 Google，所以美國可能是報復。印度因對進口車徵收關稅而擁有汽車工業及一些出口。為所有半導體公司提供設計服務但不在本地製造，並從中國購買隧道掘進機等重型工程設備。若不建立能力則目光短淺。中國不會購買，美國最終會設置關稅和非關稅壁壘。需要本地能力用於自身消費。很高興緩慢地在國內鐵路引擎、信號系統、重型設備、核能等方面取得進展。應專注製造更多，而非董事會政治或面子損失的憤怒。
text:
It is true that china banned facebook and google etc earlier so maybe it's a tit for tat by america instead. 

But then. We have a car industry domestically and now some exports because we have applied tariffs on car imports (not banned them). We do design services for all semiconductor companies but we don't make them here, and indeed even buy heavy engineering stuff like tunnel borers from China. This is short sighted, if we don't build capability. China isn't going to buy our stuff. America eventually will put tariff and non tariff barriers on our stuff. We need local capability not as much for exports but for our own consumption. I'm glad we are getting there slowly, with domestic rail engines, signalling systems, some heavy equipment, nuclear etc. Just need to put head down and make more, the focus on boardroom politics or outrage about loss of face is misguided imo

zh_summary: 企業盈利增長將放緩：標普500的11個板塊中有10個預計Q3 2026年同比盈利增長低於Q2。非必需消費從+91%降至+2%，通訊服務從+126%降至+66%，金融從+22.3%降至+2.4%，能源從+147.8%降至+122.5%，資訊科技從+77.9%降至+65.9%。將是事件豐富的業績季。
text:
Corporate earnings growth is set to slow:

10 of the 11 sectors in the S&P 500 are estimated to record lower YoY earnings growth in Q3 2026, compared to Q2.

The Consumer Discretionary sector is expected to post the largest slowdown, from +91% YoY in Q2 to just +2% YoY in Q3.

This is followed by Communication Services, with projected Q3 earnings growth at +66%, down from +126%.

Earnings growth in the Financials sector is estimated to decrease to +2.4% from +22.3%.

Energy and Information Technology, the two best-performing S&P 500 sectors, are expected to see earnings growth decline from +147.8% to +122.5% and from +77.9% to +65.9%, respectively.

We are set for an eventful earnings season.

Combined with a 200L tank in the rear, available only on the Thrust and Rocket trims, the Rocket trim will have a total capacity of 600L.

Rocket trim comes with 10 total thrusters around the vehicle: Four rear-facing, four downward-facing, and two side-facing.

• Performance trim: Four rear fans, suction system and front and rear deployable skirts.
• Thrust trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts & four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank).
• Rocket trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts, four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank), four-downward facing & two side facing thrusters (with 400L COPV tank).
